name: Pollinator Paradise
description: Designed with wildlife in mind, this sunny border garden is packed with Purple Coneflower, Black-eyed Susans, Anise Hyssop, Common Yarrow, and Mexican Sunflower to attract butterflies, bees, and hummingbirds throughout the season.

name: Birdbath Bloomery
description: A sunny cottage-style border anchored by a classic white birdbath and overflowing with Black-eyed Susans, Marigolds, Surprise Lilies, and Shrub Roses for layered color from midsummer into fall.

name: The Rose Walk
description: A winding gravel path bordered by David Austin English roses and fragrant lavender. Visitors are welcomed by a classic white arbor draped in climbing New Dawn roses.

name: Shade Sanctuary
description: Nestled beneath mature oaks, this woodland garden showcases native ferns, hostas, and hellebores. A small water feature provides a tranquil backdrop for shade-loving perennials.
